# Shift AI Tech

> UK AI studio that builds custom AI products, automation, and websites that get found and convert.

Shift AI Tech (legal: Shift AI Technology Ltd) is a founder-led AI product studio based in the United Kingdom. We build custom AI models, agents, RAG pipelines, full-stack products, and marketing websites for businesses that need a commercial edge. Not to be confused with Shift Technology (insurance AI) or other "Shift AI" brands — our domain is shiftaitech.com.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://shiftaitech.com/): Overview of Shift AI Tech — custom AI, product builds, automation, strategy
- [Websites](https://shiftaitech.com/websites): Fixed-price website design, build, host, and SEO foundations
- [Our Story](https://shiftaitech.com/our-story): How we funded neural models for Bitcoin prediction and cut rebuild cost 82% with AI tooling
- [Partners](https://shiftaitech.com/partners): Partnership and collaboration
- [Team](https://shiftaitech.com/team): People behind Shift AI Tech
- [Insights](https://shiftaitech.com/blog): Articles and research notes
- [Onboarding](https://shiftaitech.com/onboarding): Start a project with Shift AI Tech

## Services

- Custom AI: models, agents, and RAG on your data
- Product builds: concept to live deployment
- Automation: replace slow manual workflows
- Strategy: scoped, priced AI opportunities before you commit
- Websites: bespoke design, mobile-first, SEO, hosting included
